title: Replace ULA with Yggdrasil 02xx:: in ipv6_addr.c/h
description: Remove lichen_make_ula() and ULA address construction from ipv6_addr.c. Add 02xx:: Yggdrasil global address derivation from node identity. Update ipv6_addr.h declarations accordingly. Files: lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.c, lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/ipv6_addr.h. ~20 lines across 2 files. No deps.
close_reason: Removed dead lichen_make_ula() (ipv6_addr.c impl + ipv6_addr.h decl/docs); zero production or test callers existed (fixture helpers are independent statics, tracked in 025x). 02xx:: Yggdrasil derivation (lichen_yggdrasil_addr) already implemented and vector-covered, so the 'add' half of this bead was already satisfied. Header file-doc updated (ULA dropped, GUA kept for prefix-delegation compatibility). 3x kimi-k3 review: security PASS, edge PASS (confirmed firmware/bridge-zephyr copy is self-contained, gcc-14 pubkey_to_iid failure pre-existing at base), correctness PASS with fixture note -> commented on 025x. pubkey_to_iid host suite passes (clang-20, ASan/UBSan, -Werror).
